mode: Reach multiplayer custom game on Forge World

movement.doubleJump.label: Disabled (unused by engine according to RVT)

override_audit: Inspect options.respawn.traits and traitsDuration; keep movement/ability entries Unchanged so they do not alter the explicit base, or make them identical to base.
Disable loadouts or give every available loadout exactly the chosen ability; inspect Spartan and Elite palettes.
Disable armor ability and powerup pickups in options.map.flags; inspect red/blue/yellow traits and durations anyway.
Inspect scriptData.traits plus decompiled apply_traits calls, conditional branches, trait zones, objective/carrying states, spawn states and biped replacement actions.
Record gametype filename and SHA256, map filename and SHA256, MCC/Reach build, platform, controller/input method, session conditions and allowed movement techniques.
An Unchanged field is a separate sentinel, not encoded 100%; the effective inherited or overriding value must be resolved before calculation.
Keep crouching in normal movement; specify whether crouch-assisted jumps are required and calibrate separately.
No universal sprint toggle exists in these traits: Sprint is ability 0 and its use depends on abilityUsage, loadouts/pickups and state. A sprint course needs its own tested profile.
limitations: RVT parses values and displays meanings; engine formulas and exact overlay precedence are not established by these source records.
The profile sets UI percentages, not recovered physical acceleration/velocity values.
The experimental Double Jump field must not be relied on as an available parkour action.
